detailed_description: ICS File Generator creates a downloadable .ics calendar file from an event title, start date and time, end date and time, optional location, optional description, and optional event URL. The tool formats a VCALENDAR and VEVENT block with DTSTART, DTEND, SUMMARY, LOCATION, DESCRIPTION, URL, and a deterministic UID, then downloads the generated file with a sanitized event filename. It is useful when you need a quick calendar event file for a meeting, milestone, webinar, reminder, or internal planning note.
usage_steps: Enter the event title, start and end date, start and end time, and timezone
Add optional location and description details
Click Download .ics File to generate and download the calendar event file
Test the downloaded file with your calendar workflow before sharing widely
usage_examples: Draft an ICS block for a product planning meeting
Check that a one-hour UTC event has the expected DTSTART and DTEND values
Prepare a downloadable event file for an email, documentation page, or internal note

faqs.question: Is the ICS File Generator free?
faqs.answer: Yes. The generator runs in the browser and does not require an account.

faqs.question: Does the page download a calendar file?
faqs.answer: Yes. After you enter a valid event title and date range, the page downloads a .ics calendar file generated in the browser.

faqs.question: How are timezones handled?
faqs.answer: The timezone field is included in the generated DTSTART and DTEND lines unless you use UTC, which is written with a Z suffix.
